senses.gloss: com. (v. נִיסְכָּא) made of cast metal, opp. ארוקתא of wrought or stretched metal.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 59b:5">Sabb. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>דא׳ כ״ע וכ׳</he> (Rashi ed. <he>דניסכא</he>) as to those made of cast metal there is no difference of opinion.
<cite ref="Shabbat 59b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>א׳ עיקר</he> (prob. to be read <cite ref="M01289"><he>מיקר</he></cite>, v. Ms. M.) what is made of cast metal is more precious (original).
